name: ewatu-erp
description: E-Watu HR ERP — microservices (from EWatu v1.1 spec)

scripts.build:all: npm run build:common-auth && npm run build:platform && npm run build:identity && npm run build:document && npm run build:notification && npm run build:recruitment && npm run build:talent-pool && npm run build:payroll && npm run build:procurement
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n identity,platform,notification,recruitment,web -c blue,green,cyan,yellow,white "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:recruitment" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n identity,platform,recruitment,talent-pool,payroll,procurement,document,notification,web -c blue,green,yellow,red,white,orange,magenta,cyan,gray "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:recruitment" "npm run dev:talent-pool" "npm run dev:payroll" "npm run dev:procurement" "npm run dev:document" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio mailpit
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate:identity && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix services/platform-service && npm run db:migrate:recruitment && npm run db:migrate:notification && npm run db:migrate:talent-pool && npm run db:migrate:payroll && npm run prisma:push --prefix services/procurement-service
scripts.db:seed:dev: npm run prisma:seed --prefix services/platform-service && npm run prisma:seed --prefix services/identity-service
